q.en: What do you refer to when analysing an audience in persuasion?

a.en: Demographics, psychographics, motivation.
a.ms: Demografi, psikografi, motivasi.

a.en: “You” attitude, limited scope, explain reason, build interest, ask for decision/action, choose approach.
a.ms: Sikap “you”, skop terhad, terangkan sebab, bina minat, minta keputusan/tindakan, pilih pendekatan.

a.en: Positive polite language, respect cultural differences, sensitivity to organisational cultures, establish credibility.
a.ms: Bahasa positif sopan, hormati budaya, peka budaya organisasi, bina kredibiliti.

a.en: Simple language, objective evidence, identify sources, common ground, objectivity, fair arguments, audience’s best interests, logic.

a.en: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action.
a.ms: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action.

q.en: Four factors in balancing emotional and logical appeals?
q.ms: Empat faktor mengimbangi rayuan emosi dan logik?

a.en: Action to motivate, readers’ expectations, degree of resistance, position in power structure.
a.ms: Tindakan, jangkaan pembaca, tahap tentangan, kedudukan dalam struktur kuasa.

a.en: Analogy, induction, deduction.
a.ms: Analogi, induksi, deduksi.

a.en: Hasty generalisations, circular reasoning, attacking an opponent, oversimplifying, mistaken cause and effect, faulty analogies, illogical support.

a.en: Believable evidence, examine language, metaphors and analogies, audience benefits.

a.en: Identify resistance, find solutions, present all sides, explain pros and cons.
a.ms: Kenal pasti tentangan, cari penyelesaian, bentang semua sisi, terangkan kebaikan dan keburukan.

a.en: Hard sell, resisting compromise, relying solely on great arguments, one-shot approach.

a.en: Requests for action, presentations of ideas, claims and requests for adjustment.

a.en: Review facts positively, outline problem and status, specific resolution, good reason, respectful close.

a.en: Marketing: no immediate decision, introduces new products. Sales: asks for an immediate decision, requests to buy a specific product.
a.ms: Pemasaran: tiada keputusan segera, perkenal produk baru. Jualan: keputusan segera, minta beli produk tertentu.
